verdict.rationale: Google Calendar does offer appointment booking pages, so collecting payment at booking is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack shows Stripe or any other payment collection tied to booking. The only booking evidence is a bare pricing-page mention of 'Appointment booking pages', with no reference to paid sessions.

support.subject: As a founder, I can collect payment (e.g. via Stripe) at the moment of booking for paid sessions
